svg.title: A cold key turns 40 readers into 40 identical queries
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “A cold key turns 40 readers into 40 identical queries” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A three-layer stack with the repository Protocol marked as the swap point tests replace. Below, forty concurrent readers all miss a cold cache and all reach the database — forty calls in 1784 milliseconds, with the fan of arrows crossed out — against the same readers funnelled through a single-flight loader into one database call in 85 milliseconds. A timeline at the bottom shades the stale window between the write and the TTL expiry.
